sources.subject: A note from the shop manager

text.clean: Hello. I sent the parcel back with the original packaging and the receipt inside. The item arrived with a cracked base and the switch only worked intermittently. Our front desk will close early on Friday afternoon for an office move. Regards, Rafi (the shop manager)
text.neutral:
FYI: housekeeping notes

• Heads-up: the front desk closes early this Friday afternoon because the office is moving.
• When it arrived, the base was cracked and the switch worked only some of the time.
• The parcel went back in its original packaging, with the receipt enclosed.

No reply required.
Rafi (the shop manager)
